title: Conserved homogeneous base energy controls the recurrent radial coefficient

coefficient_control.conservation: Pairing the reduced equation with u' gives dH_0/dt=0.
coefficient_control.cutoff_uniformity: The bounds use only H_0,m and lambda and contain no spectral cutoff or norm of Q_N.
coefficient_control.recurrence_boundary: The coefficient may be periodic or recurrent and need not belong to L1(R); pointwise boundedness is the input for finite-time Gronwall.
coefficient_control.boundary: This controls the spatially constant homogeneous coefficient, not partial_t||phi(t,x)||^2 in L-infinity_x for the full PDE.
